source.text:
Schedule 3 No Shooting or Hunting Areas (Section 4)
Nitinat River
44 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in M.U.s 1-3 and 1-4 that is contained within the following described boundaries: Commencing at a point on the midline of Nitinat River at its intersection with the westerly boundary of Indian Reserve #15; thence in a general southerly direction along the midline of Nitinat River to the natural boundary of Nitinat Lake on the northerly shore thereof and including all intervening territory for 500 metres on either side of the midline of Nitinat River. [en. B.C. Reg. 204/91, s. 2.]
